text:
Which statement about the uses of aluminium, mild steel and stainless steel is correct?
A
Aluminium is used for food containers as it has a high density.
B
Mild steel is used for car bodies as it is resistant to corrosion.
C
Stainless steel is used for aircraft bodies as it is strong.
D
Stainless steel is used for cutlery as it is resistant to corrosion.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is used for food containers as it has a high density.

options.label: B
options.text: Mild steel is used for car bodies as it is resistant to corrosion.

options.label: C
options.text: Stainless steel is used for aircraft bodies as it is strong.

options.label: D
